error.enquiryNotAccepted: A contract can only be created from an enquiry the provider has accepted.
error.notClient: Only the client of this contract can do this.
error.notProvider: Only the provider of this contract can do this.
error.notParty: Only the two parties of this contract can do this.
error.duplicateContract: This enquiry already has a live contract.
error.invalidTransition: This action isn't possible in the contract's current state.
error.draftOnly: Milestones can only be changed while the contract is a draft.
error.hourlyNoManualMilestones: An hourly contract is paid from approved timesheets, not from manually added milestones.
error.hourlyRateRequired: An hourly contract needs an hourly rate and a weekly hours cap.
error.milestonesRequired: Add at least one milestone before sending the contract.
error.milestonesMustSumToTotal: Milestones must add up to the contract total ({total}).
error.milestoneNotFundable: This milestone can't be funded right now.
error.milestoneNotFunded: This milestone has to be funded before work is submitted.
error.milestoneNotSubmitted: This milestone hasn't been submitted for approval.
error.paymentUnavailable: Payment service is unavailable right now. Please try again later.
error.heldFundsClientOnly: Held payments are still on this contract. Only the client can cancel it; you can open a dispute instead.
error.submittedBlocksCancel: Approve or send back the submitted milestones before cancelling.
error.notCompletable: Every funded milestone has to be released or refunded before the contract can be completed.
error.weekStartNotMonday: Week start must be a Monday.
error.weekInFuture: You can't submit hours for a week that hasn't started.
error.weeklyCapExceeded: Hours exceed this contract's weekly cap of {cap}.
error.timesheetDuplicateWeek: A timesheet for this week already exists.
error.budgetExceeded: This would exceed the contract's budget of {total}.
error.disputeAlreadyOpen: A dispute is already open on this contract.

outcome.resolved_client: resolved in the client's favour, held payments refunded
outcome.resolved_provider: resolved in the provider's favour, held payments released
outcome.closed: closed without a change, the contract continues

paymentNotice.sandbox: Test mode: payments on this contract go through a sandbox and no real money moves.
paymentNotice.live: The client pays each milestone in advance and Vyapar records it as held. It is released to the provider when the client approves the work, or automatically 14 days after submission.
